name: create-barcode
title: Create Barcode
description: Generate EAN-13, ITF, NW-7 (Codabar), CODE39 and CODE128 barcodes as you type, preview them instantly, and export them as PNG or SVG.
author: togashi12

commands.name: create-barcode
commands.title: Create Barcode
commands.subtitle: EAN-13 / ITF / NW-7 / CODE39 / CODE128
commands.description: Type a value to render a barcode. Every matching symbology is listed so you can switch between them, and a 12-digit EAN-13 gets its check digit calculated for you.

preferences.name: savePath
preferences.title: Save Folder
preferences.description: Folder to save PNG / SVG files to. Defaults to the Downloads folder when empty.

preferences.name: pngScale
preferences.title: PNG Scale
preferences.description: Pixels per barcode module in exported PNG files.
